task_text: Order, display, and maintain supplies.
rationale: ordering is agentic but display and physical maintenance are not

task_text: Comb, brush, and spray hair or wigs to set style.
Develop new styles and techniques.
rationale: can research trends but physical testing needed to validate

task_text: Apply water or setting, straightening or waving solutions to hair, and use curlers, rollers, hot combs and curling irons to press and curl hair.
Shape eyebrows and remove facial hair, using depilatory cream, tweezers, electrolysis or wax.
Shave, trim, and shape beards and moustaches.
Train or supervise other hairstylists, hairdressers, and assistants.
rationale: hands-on training and supervision need physical presence

task_text: Massage and treat scalp for hygienic and remedial purposes, using hands, fingers, or vibrating equipment.
Administer therapeutic medication and advise patron to seek medical treatment for chronic or contagious scalp conditions.
rationale: administering medication needs physical presence and licensure

task_text: Recommend and explain the use of cosmetics, lotions, and creams to soften and lubricate skin and enhance and restore natural appearance.
Clean, shape, and polish fingernails and toenails, using files and nail polish.
Give facials to patrons, using special compounds, such as lotions and creams.
Attach wigs or hairpieces to model heads and dress wigs and hairpieces according to instructions, samples, sketches or photographs.
Clean supplies such as makeup brushes.
Duplicate work precisely to replicate characters' appearances on a daily basis.
Apply makeup to enhance or alter the appearance of people appearing in productions such as movies.
Analyze a script, noting events that affect each character's appearance, so that plans can be made for each scene.
Alter or maintain makeup during productions as necessary to compensate for lighting changes or to achieve continuity of effect.
Confer with stage or motion picture officials and performers to determine desired effects.
rationale: creative discussion benefits from in-person presence though partly doable via chat

task_text: Requisition or acquire needed materials for special effects, including wigs, beards, and special cosmetics.
rationale: procurement and ordering is largely agentic

task_text: Study production information, such as character descriptions, period settings, and situations, to determine makeup requirements.
Establish budgets, and work within budgetary limits.
rationale: budgeting and financial tracking is agentic

task_text: Select desired makeup shades from stock, or mix oil, grease, and coloring to achieve specific color effects.
Write makeup sheets and take photos to document specific looks and the products used to achieve the looks.
rationale: writing feasible but taking photos requires physical presence

task_text: Assess performers' skin type to ensure that makeup will not cause break-outs or skin irritations.
Attach prostheses to performers and apply makeup to create special features or effects, such as scars, aging, or illness.
Examine sketches, photographs, and plaster models to obtain desired character image depiction.
rationale: visual analysis of images and sketches feasible for agent

task_text: Cleanse and tone the skin to prepare it for makeup application.
Evaluate environmental characteristics, such as venue size and lighting plans, to determine makeup requirements.
rationale: can review venue and lighting plans remotely though on-site check helps

task_text: Provide performers with makeup removal assistance after performances have been completed.
Design rubber or plastic prostheses that can be used to change performers' appearances.
rationale: digital prosthesis design feasible but physical fabrication and fitting not

task_text: Create character drawings or models, based upon independent research, to augment period production files.
rationale: research and drawing feasible via image generation though physical models not

task_text: Demonstrate products to clients, and provide instruction in makeup application.
Advise hairdressers on the hairstyles required for character parts.
Wash and reset wigs.
Clean and sanitize tools and work environment.
Apply undercoat and clear or colored polish onto nails with brush.
Maintain supply inventories and records of client services.
rationale: record keeping and inventory tracking is agentic

Prepare nail cuticles with water and oil, using cuticle knives to push back cuticles and scissors or nippers to trim cuticles.
Prepare customers' nails in soapy water, using swabs, files, and orange sticks.
Remove previously applied nail polish, using liquid remover and swabs.
Use rotary abrasive wheels to shape and smooth nails or artificial extensions.
Schedule client appointments and accept payments.
rationale: scheduling and payment processing is agentic

Roughen surfaces of fingernails, using abrasive wheel.
Advise clients on nail care and use of products and colors.
Treat nails to repair or improve strength and resilience by wrapping.
Extend nails using powder, solvent, and paper forms attached to tips of customers' fingers to support and shape artificial nails.
Polish nails, using powdered polish and buffer.
Whiten underside of nails with white paste or pencils.
Promote and sell nail care products.
rationale: marketing content feasible but in-person retail sales needs human presence

task_text: Decorate clients' nails by piercing or attaching ornaments or designs.
Massage, shampoo, and condition patron's hair and scalp to clean them and remove excess oil.
Advise patrons with chronic or potentially contagious scalp conditions to seek medical treatment.
rationale: requires physical observation of scalp condition first

task_text: Treat scalp conditions and hair loss, using specialized lotions, shampoos, or equipment such as infrared lamps or vibrating equipment.
Maintain treatment records.
Sterilize equipment and clean work areas.
Cleanse clients' skin with water, creams, or lotions.
Demonstrate how to clean and care for skin properly and recommend skin-care regimens.
rationale: demonstration is physical though recommendations could be given via text

task_text: Determine which products or colors will improve clients' skin quality and appearance.
rationale: could analyze photos though in-person assessment is typical

task_text: Keep records of client needs and preferences and the services provided.
Treat the facial skin to maintain and improve its appearance, using specialized techniques and products, such as peels and masks.
Examine clients' skin, using magnifying lamps or visors when necessary, to evaluate skin condition and appearance.
Perform simple extractions to remove blackheads.
Select and apply cosmetic products, such as creams, lotions, and tonics.
rationale: physical product selection and application on client

task_text: Stay abreast of latest industry trends, products, research, and treatments.
rationale: pure research and reading of industry trends

task_text: Apply chemical peels to reduce fine lines and age spots.
Refer clients to medical personnel for treatment of serious skin problems.
Provide facial and body massages.
Remove body and facial hair by applying wax.
Tint eyelashes and eyebrows.
Collaborate with plastic surgeons and dermatologists to provide patients with preoperative and postoperative skin care.
rationale: coordination feasible but hands-on care and clinical accountability not

task_text: Advise clients about colors and types of makeup and instruct them in makeup application techniques.
rationale: advisory portion feasible though hands-on instruction is not

task_text: Sell makeup to clients.
rationale: in-person retail sales needs human presence

task_text: Receive and mark baggage by completing and attaching claim checks.
rationale: physical baggage handling though claim check paperwork is minor digital part

task_text: Greet incoming guests and escort them to their rooms.
Transport guests about premises and local areas, or arrange for transportation.
rationale: arranging transportation is agentic but physically transporting guests is not

task_text: Maintain clean lobbies or entrance areas for travelers or guests.
Transfer luggage, trunks, and packages to and from rooms, loading areas, vehicles, or transportation terminals, by hand or using baggage carts.
Supply guests or travelers with directions, travel information, and other information, such as available services and points of interest.
rationale: pure informational task like a concierge chatbot

task_text: Explain the operation of room features, such as locks, ventilation systems, and televisions.
rationale: explaining room features is largely informational

task_text: Assist travelers and guests with disabilities.
Deliver messages and room service orders, and run errands for guests.
rationale: physical delivery of items and errands

task_text: Pick up and return items for laundry and valet service.
Act as part of the security team at transportation terminals, hotels, or similar establishments.
Compute and complete charge slips for services rendered and maintain records.
rationale: computation and record keeping is agentic

task_text: Page guests in hotel lobbies, dining rooms, or other areas.
rationale: could trigger automated paging system though typically a physical action

task_text: Set up conference rooms, display tables, racks, or shelves, and arrange merchandise displays for sales personnel.
rationale: physical setup of rooms and displays

task_text: Inspect guests' rooms to ensure that they are adequately stocked, orderly, and comfortable.
Complete baggage insurance forms.
Arrange for shipments of baggage, express mail, and parcels by providing weighing and billing services.
rationale: arranging shipment and billing is agentic but weighing is physical

Make reservations for patrons, such as for dinner, spa treatments, or golf tee times, and obtain tickets to special events.
rationale: booking reservations via calls or apps is agentic

task_text: Provide directions to guests.
Order flowers for guests.
Make travel arrangements for sightseeing or other tours.
Pick up and deliver items or run errands for guests.
rationale: physical pickup and delivery of items

task_text: Plan special events, parties, or meetings, which may include booking musicians or celebrities.
rationale: event planning and booking largely doable remotely

task_text: Book airline or train tickets, reserve rental cars, or arrange shuttle service for guests.
rationale: booking tickets and reservations is agentic

task_text: Arrange childcare services for guests.
rationale: arranging bookings feasible though vetting caregivers benefits from human judgment

task_text: Carry out unusual requests, such as searching for hard-to-find items or arranging for exotic services, such as hot-air balloon rides.
rationale: searching and arranging services via calls and web is largely agentic

task_text: Assist guests with special needs by providing equipment such as wheelchairs.
Receive, store, or deliver luggage or mail.
rationale: physical receiving and delivery of luggage

task_text: Perform office duties on a temporary basis when needed.
Arrange for the replacement of items lost by travelers.
Provide business services for guests, such as sending or receiving faxes or shipping packages.
rationale: sending faxes could be digital but shipping packages is physical

task_text: Arrange for interpreters or translators when patrons require such services.
rationale: arranging or directly providing translation services is largely agentic

task_text: Provide food and beverage services to guests.
Clean and tidy hotel lounge.
Describe tour points of interest to group members, and respond to questions.
rationale: could function as automated audio guide though live in-person interaction is typical

Monitor visitors' activities to ensure compliance with establishment or tour regulations and safety practices.
rationale: requires physical presence and authority to ensure safety compliance

task_text: Conduct educational activities for school children.
rationale: requires physical presence for supervising children

Provide directions and other pertinent information to visitors.
Select travel routes and sites to be visited based on knowledge of specific areas.
rationale: route planning using maps and research is agentic

task_text: Provide for physical safety of groups, performing such activities as providing first aid or directing emergency evacuations.
rationale: physical safety response and first aid

task_text: Assemble and check the required supplies and equipment prior to departure.
rationale: physical assembly and checking of equipment

task_text: Greet and register visitors, and issue any required identification badges or safety devices.
rationale: registration could be digital but greeting and issuing physical badges needs presence

task_text: Distribute brochures, show audiovisual presentations, and explain establishment processes and operations at tour sites.
rationale: distributing physical brochures needs presence though AV content could be automated

task_text: Drive motor vehicles to transport visitors to establishments and tour site locations.
Train other guides and volunteers.
rationale: hands-on guide training typically needs physical presence

task_text: Provide information about wildlife varieties and habitats, as well as any relevant regulations, such as those pertaining to hunting and fishing.
Teach skills, such as proper climbing methods, and demonstrate and advise on the use of equipment.
rationale: physical demonstration of climbing and equipment use

task_text: Collect fees and tickets from group members.
rationale: digital payment collection feasible but physical ticket collection needs presence

task_text: Perform clerical duties, such as filing, typing, operating switchboards, or routing mail and messages.
rationale: much clerical and digital messaging work is agentic though filing and mail routing are physical

task_text: Solicit tour patronage and sell souvenirs.
rationale: digital solicitation feasible but in-person souvenir sales needs presence

task_text: Speak foreign languages to communicate with foreign visitors.
rationale: agent can communicate and translate across languages

task_text: Arrange for tour or expedition details such as accommodations, transportation, equipment, and the availability of medical personnel.
rationale: planning and booking arrangements is largely agentic
